metrics.name: Return to a saved ad
metrics.definition: users who open an ad from Favourites / users who view Favourites

metrics.name: Accidental removals
metrics.definition: a favourite_toggle that removes an ad followed by a favourite_toggle that re-saves the same ad within a minute. Needs the parameter that tells the two directions apart: see open_questions.

open_questions.q: favourite_toggle is one live event for both directions. Which parameter says whether the ad was saved or removed? Observe a heart tap in GTM Preview on the Mac, signed in.
Does favourite_toggle accept a surface parameter, and is "favourites" an accepted value? E2 and E3 assume it does.
